Conclusion: Weather strongly predicts late/failed (p < 0.001). Late rate ranges 12.9% (cold) to 32.5% (stormy).
Partner differences in late/failed rate are not statistically significant (p = 0.081). Late rate spans only 2.6 pp across partners.
No evidence that vehicle type affects delivery cost (p = 0.842). Cost is driven by distance, not vehicle.
Non-parametric test confirms no difference in cost by vehicle type (p = 0.839).
Strong negative correlation (ρ = -0.567, p < 0.001). Later deliveries get lower ratings.
